data.name: Hapijul
data.gender_notes: Hapijul is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hapijul is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘hap’ meaning ‘joy’ and ‘ijul’ meaning ‘grace from the gods’. This name signifies the divine grace bestowed upon a child. The name Hapijul carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hapijul usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hapijul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hapijul total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Hapijul derives from the Sanskrit words "Hapi" (joy, happiness) and "Jul" (flowing, moving). It symbolizes the constant flow of joy and happiness within an individual, reflecting their inner peace and contentment.
